arg.name: zero_when_static
arg.description: If true, the node forces output to zero when no motion is detected to prevent drift.

arg.name: static_count_threshold
arg.description: Number of empty polls required to determine the device is static.

arg.name: static_trans_deadband
arg.description: Threshold up to which input translational motion is being interpreted as static.

arg.name: static_rot_deadband
arg.description: Threshold up to which input rotational motion is being interpreted as static.

arg.name: full_scale
arg.description: Full scale normalization factor for raw sensor readings.

arg.name: linear_scale_x
arg.description: Scale factor for linear X-axis output.

arg.name: linear_scale_y
arg.description: Scale factor for linear Y-axis output.

arg.name: linear_scale_z
arg.description: Scale factor for linear Z-axis output.

arg.name: angular_scale_x
arg.description: Scale factor for angular X-axis output.

arg.name: angular_scale_y
arg.description: Scale factor for angular Y-axis output.

arg.name: angular_scale_z
arg.description: Scale factor for angular Z-axis output.

arg.name: use_twist_stamped
arg.description: If true, publish geometry_msgs/TwistStamped instead of geometry_msgs/Twist.
